name: noun-paladin
prompt: Holy paladin warrior character. Polished silver plate armour with gold trim and a sun emblem on the chest, a long sword strapped to the back and a kite shield on the off-arm, helmet held under the arm revealing a noble determined face, a cloak draped from the shoulders.

name: noun-robot
prompt: Industrial heavy-duty robot character — distinct from the lithe barracks robot. Bulky boxy chassis, exposed pistons at the joints, single cyclopean glowing optic sensor at the head height, heavy clamp hands, factory yellow and grey paint with hazard stripes.

name: noun-mech
prompt: Piloted humanoid mech suit character. Tall heavy battle mech with thick angular armour plates, large pauldrons, a cockpit hatch suggestion on the chest, jet thrusters on the back, an integrated gauntlet weapon on the right arm. Stylised Pixar-clean mecha.

name: noun-alien
prompt: Otherworldly humanoid alien character. Slender elongated limbs, large dark almond eyes on a smooth elongated head, smooth iridescent purple-grey skin, simple ceremonial robe at the hips, four-fingered hands at the sides. Friendly demeanor.

name: noun-zombie
prompt: Stylised undead zombie character. Pale grey-green skin, tattered ragged clothes, slumped shoulders, one arm reaching forward in classic shamble, head tilted to one side, mouth slightly open. Cartoony not gruesome — Pixar-clean undead.

name: noun-viking
prompt: Northern viking warrior character. Heavy fur cloak draped over chainmail and leather armour, horned helmet (or single horn), a large two-handed axe held across the body, long braided beard visible, knee-high leather boots, bracers.

name: noun-pirate
prompt: Seafaring pirate character. Tricorn captain's hat, long flowing dark coat with brass buttons, a curved cutlass at the hip, a sash with a flintlock pistol tucked in, an eyepatch over one eye, sea boots, confident swaggering stance.

name: noun-bird
prompt: Stylised generic songbird. Plump round body with smooth feathered geometry, small round head with a tiny beak, large friendly cartoon eyes, feet perched as if mid-step, wings folded against the body. Tiny — small contact shadow on the floor.

name: noun-eagle
prompt: Stylised majestic eagle creature. Strong perched stance with talons gripping an invisible surface, large sharp hooked beak, fierce focused eyes, full feathered body, wings folded but slightly raised in alertness.

name: noun-owl
prompt: Stylised nocturnal owl creature. Round plump body with mottled brown feathers, a large round head with very large round eyes and a small hooked beak, ear tufts, talons gripping an invisible perch, wings folded.

name: noun-dragon
prompt: Stylised mythical dragon creature. Quadrupedal pose with large folded leathery wings on the back, long serpentine neck and tail, scaled iridescent purple-blue body, small horns on the head, friendly intelligent eyes. Pixar-cute not menacing.

name: noun-wolf
prompt: Stylised forest wolf creature. Lean muscular four-legged stance, thick grey and white fur with subtle markings, alert pointed ears, sharp focused yellow eyes, bushy tail held low and level, paws planted firmly.

name: noun-horse
prompt: Stylised mountable horse creature. Strong four-legged standing pose, chestnut brown coat with a flowing dark mane and tail, alert ears forward, intelligent eyes, well-defined musculature, hooves planted firmly.

name: noun-deer
prompt: Stylised forest deer creature. Slender four-legged stance, tan coat with a white belly, large branching antlers, large gentle dark eyes, ears alert and raised, slender legs delicately planted.

name: noun-bear
prompt: Stylised large brown bear creature. Massive four-legged stance, thick fluffy brown fur, large round paws with visible claws, small round ears on a broad head, intelligent brown eyes, slight cute round belly.

name: noun-lion
prompt: Stylised proud lion creature. Strong four-legged standing pose, golden tan coat with a thick flowing mane around the head, large amber eyes, alert ears, paws planted firmly, tail with a tufted tip held low.

name: noun-snake
prompt: Stylised coiled snake creature. Body coiled in tight S-curves on the ground with the head raised at the top alert and turned toward camera, green-and-yellow patterned smooth scales, tongue slightly out, intelligent eyes.

name: noun-spider
prompt: Stylised eight-legged spider creature. All eight legs planted on the floor in a wide stable spread, plump round body with subtle marking, eight small intelligent eyes on the head, body raised slightly off the ground. Cute not creepy.

name: noun-fish
prompt: Stylised generic fish creature, floating in mid-air as if suspended for a product shot. Smooth streamlined body with iridescent blue-green scales, large friendly cartoon eye, gently spread fins, mouth slightly open, captured in a side-profile view at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-shark
prompt: Stylised great shark creature suspended in mid-air for a product shot. Streamlined torpedo body with a grey top and white belly, prominent dorsal fin, sharp toothy grin, focused eyes, in profile at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-butterfly
prompt: Stylised colourful butterfly creature. Small plump body with two pairs of large open wings spread wide and slightly forward, vivid iridescent blue and orange wing patterns, delicate antennae, the entire creature suspended in mid-air.
